transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Hello, this is calling from our company. Is this a good time to talk about your account?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.message: Hi, yes, this is Chloe. I’ve been expecting your call, and I do want to take care of this. Is now a good time? I’m happy to talk and figure things out.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message:
Hi Chloe, this is ${agent_name} from ${company_name}. Thanks so much for picking up and being proactive—I really appreciate that. Yes, now works well, and I’m here to help make this as manageable as possible for you.

For clarity, I should mention that I’m reaching out regarding your outstanding account with us. But I hear you’re ready to work on a solution, which is great. I’ll do my best to understand your situation and offer some realistic options.

To get started, would you be comfortable sharing a bit about your current financial situation? Things like your income, any recent changes, or expenses that might be affecting your ability to pay? The more I know, the better I can help tailor a plan that works for you.
